body.message:
Dear Ms. Catarina,

Thank you for your email. We would like to respond to the points raised.

Regarding the annual tenancy: as communicated to you directly in writing, any extended or blocked booking, including an annual arrangement, required advance payment to be confirmed and secured. No advance payment was made toward a 12-month tenancy at any point, and no written confirmation of a binding annual agreement at AED 250,000 was issued. Discussions around an annual rate were preliminary and expressly conditional on advance payment, which was never received.

Regarding availability and notice: you were informed on multiple occasions, including via WhatsApp, that the apartment is listed across multiple platforms and receives ongoing bookings, and that availability could not be guaranteed beyond short notice. You were advised to contact our helpline promptly to arrange any extension. Your booking covering August through 4 September was on this basis, and no extension was confirmed or paid for beyond that date.

Regarding the conduct complaint: our team attended the apartment solely to carry out a standard checkout in relation to your expired booking. We deny any conduct intended to threaten or frighten your children or staff, and this was communicated to you directly at the time.

Regarding your request for documentation: we will review our records regarding the DET permit, lease terms, and relevant correspondence, and will follow up separately on this point.

We understand this situation has been stressful for you and your family, and we remain willing to work toward a fair resolution. However, we are not in a position to honor an annual tenancy that was never confirmed or secured with advance payment, nor to reverse the completed checkout.

We note that this matter is now under DET case no. GOV-320439-W0F0Q, and we will continue to cooperate with that process.

Regards,
